rootCauseOneLine: The hard-coded Cursor picker policy BUILT_IN_ACP_LAUNCH_SPECS["acp-cursor"].modelCli.primaryModels in packages/agent-runtime/src/acp-launch-specs.ts still names the exact family id cursor-grok-4.5-medium, and splitPrimaryModels matches by exact id, so the discovered Grok 4.6 family (cursor-grok-4.6-medium) is classified selected-only (More models / omitted from bb provider models).

prReviews.topFinding: Edits packages/agent-runtime/src/acp/profiles.ts, which #1640 (c5b53caab) deleted; the live policy is packages/agent-runtime/src/acp-launch-specs.ts:32. GitHub reports CONFLICTING and a naive rebase is a no-op, so it does not fix the issue on main (already closed as obsolete by maintainer; the intended one-line value change is correct and, re-targeted plus a fixture test, would be merge-quality).

proposedFix: Immediate: in packages/agent-runtime/src/acp-launch-specs.ts replace "cursor-grok-4.5-medium" with "cursor-grok-4.6-medium" (verified: repro vitest goes red to green; no HOST_DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION bump needed since only a value in an existing string[] changes; Grok 4.5 stays selectable under More models). Add the fixture-driven vitest (real cursor-agent --list-models output through parseAgentModelLines/buildAgentModelCatalog/splitPrimaryModels against the built-in policy). Durable option: stop pinning versions (family-prefix patterns picking the newest version, or move the policy server-side with a check that warns when a listed id matches nothing in the live catalog).
caveats: PR #1687 was already CLOSED (not open) when reviewed. Repro used the locally installed Cursor CLI 2026.08.11-e8db854; the unit test carries a captured fixture so it does not need Cursor. Nothing on origin/main after 16ceb3a54 touches the policy, so the bug is still present there. Left two untracked repro files in the worktree (plugins/provider-acp/src/bridge/issue-1688-*).
